scoring_justification: Agent reports only final binding energies; raw total energies are not part of the output contract, so recompute from raw artifacts (T1) is not possible. Comparison to paper gold with tolerance and structural trend check is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported binding energies for Zn on TiO2(001), TiO2(100), TiO2(101), Zn(001), Zn(100) from Fig. 1d and main text.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported values (-0.63, -0.95, -0.45, -0.68, -0.86 eV).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's primary computational results, essential for verifying reproduction.

outputs.description: Computed binding energy of Zn on each surface.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the submitted binding energies to reference values and validates the relative ordering trend (Zn affinity higher on (100) than on Zn surfaces, which in turn are higher than on (001) and (101)).
